The P13.14-exy executor's own outcome records module as level 2. The new r6 test pins only the phrases 'merge script already makes', find() and cite, so it does not catch the wrong level.

preExisting.issue: flowExit calls setStep(flow.i + 1) and flowEnter starts at seqState.cur - 1, both treating a frame index as a step number. flowFrames skips any step whose participants are missing, so frame i and step i + 1 diverge for such a sequence. frames[i].step holds the real step index. The v15 test cannot see this because every step of place-order yields a frame. This code was reviewed in the earlier round and is not changed by the fix tasks.
preExisting.resolution: Map through frames[flow.i].step + 1 on exit, and find the frame whose step equals the current one on enter.
